children: OPTICAL CABLE CORP reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $24.3M and diluted EPS of $0.21, driven by stronger demand in enterprise, data center and specialty markets versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share: basic and diluted”.
Revenue growth of 22.0% YoY in Q3 FY2026 was led by enterprise, data center and specialty markets.
Domestic sales increased 20.3% and international sales rose 28.8%, with stronger distributor and OEM demand.
Entered a strategic collaboration with Lightera in July 2025 to expand data center and enterprise product offerings.
Gross profit margin improved to 37.4% from 31.7% YoY, reflecting higher volumes and manufacturing leverage.
Backlog increased to $13.5M and inventories rose to support higher demand and pending shipments across facilities.
